description:
`scripts/release_artifact_consumer.py` `producer` (`:683-695`) lists the jobs of the current run attempt and requires exactly one job named `dist-artifact` with status `in_progress`. It fails intermittently with `Release artifact admission failed: producer job is not unique and running`, and a rerun passes. Each failure turns develop red, and the red-Trunk arm gate then blocks `make pr-arm` for every PR until a later Trunk run passes.

Failures: run 39614627213 (2026-10-21, head 4f5458c16); run 39615662898 attempt 1 (2026-10-21, head 7dcebb28c; attempt 2 passed); run 39794975920 (2026-10-22, head 93524639b; failed jobs rerun). That is 3 of the 60 most recent develop Trunk runs. The message does not say which condition failed, so the cause is unknown: no match, several matches, or a match whose listed status is not yet `in_progress`. Jobs-API lag is a guess, not verified.
